en: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David.

zh: 大衛的詩，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器，調用第八。

ja: 指揮者のために。弦楽器に合わせて、八弦の琴に合わせて。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

ja: めないでください。 あなたの
らしめないでください。
en: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
u.src: 1  LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

p.src: 2  Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

ja: をあわれんでください。
は恐れおののいている。
en: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
u.src: 2  Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

p.src: 3  My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?

ja: もひどく苦悩している。 しかし
en: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?
u.src: 3  My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?

p.src: 4  Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

ja: てください。私の魂を助け出し、 あなたの
en: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.
u.src: 4  Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

p.src: 5  For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

ja: えていることはないからだ。 よみ で、誰があなたに
en: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?
u.src: 5  For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

ja: 6:5 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 6:5 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 6  I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

ja: 、私は寝床を水浸しにする。 私は
en: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
u.src: 6  I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

p.src: 7  My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

ja: しみのゆえに衰え果てる。
のゆえに、それは老い衰える。
en: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
u.src: 7  My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

p.src: 8  Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.

en: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.
u.src: 8  Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.

p.src: 9  The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.

en: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.
u.src: 9  The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.

p.src: 10  May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

ja: をかき、ひどく恐れおののくだろう。
en: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
u.src: 10  May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
